plainLanguage: Section 131A — Punishment for gang rape. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata statutory elements za kifungu bila kubadilisha official text.
meaning: Section 131A must be read from its exact definitions, conduct, consent, age, intention, authority, evidential rules and sentencing provisions where applicable.
keyPoints: Use the official provision element by element.
Age, consent, intention, authority and penetration must be treated exactly as the relevant subsection provides.
Do not infer an element or penalty from the heading alone.

cases.name: Shimiyu Masunga & Another v Republic
cases.relevance: The appeal concerned gang rape under sections 130 and 131A and discusses proof of lack of consent and penetration.

history.summary: Section 131A appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official statutory text checked against the government R.E. 2022 publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory ingredient must be established from admissible evidence; the section heading is not a substitute for the elements.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Consent, age, authority relationships and statutory evidential rules should be analysed only as the relevant subsection expressly provides.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory requirement ya section 131A?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
